45K views · 130 reactions | 🪔 Watch highlights from the inauguration of our Global Technology Center in GIFT City, Gujarat, a new hub for delivering AI-led innovation for the financial services ecosystem worldwide and developing next-generation talent in the region.

🚀 The launch marks an important milestone in our growth journey and expands our footprint in India from one of the country’s most strategic business and innovation hubs. The event brought together government leaders, industry stakeholders, academic partners, employees and HCLTech leadership, including Shri Harsh Sanghavi, Hon’ble Deputy Chief Minister of Gujarat, C Vijayakumar, CEO & Managing Director, HCLTech, and Shri Sanjay Kaul, IAS, Managing Director and Group CEO, GIFT City.

🎓 The event also marked new Memoranda of Understanding with the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar and Gujarat Technological University to strengthen industry-academia collaboration and nurture future-ready technology talent in Gujarat. The center will support our continued investment in AI-led industry solutions, academic research and talent development while contributing to Gujarat’s technology ecosystem.
